quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: Solid NaCl is present (saturated solution). Saturation molality is not in Table 1; the authors tabulate it at 75, 125, 150 ... 300 C in Table 2 '(sat.)' rows and Table 5 (6.460, 6.935, 7.198, 7.573, 7.973, 8.435, 8.990, 9.640, 10.418 mol/kg). Saturation molalities are the authors' own derived solubilities (section 5.1.4: obtained by extrapolation of phi to the intersection with the line phi*m = constant), model-dependent and not measured. Row 1 (108.81 C, the temperature at which the saturated solution reaches about 1 atm) has no printed molality and is held.
caution: Saturation molality of NaCl at each temperature is the authors' extrapolated solubility (Table 2 '(sat.)' / Table 5), not a measured value; the 108.81 C row has no printed molality.
